name: Mould Maker
description: Printed moulds sized to your printer. Round: bowls, planters. Box: flat-sided parts. Silicone sleeve: plug, split sleeve and base for a silicone liner. Big round moulds take two runs: if only the jacket appears, run again.

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: K1 Max: 300 × 300 × 300 mm build volume. Custom: the plugin uses Bed width, Bed depth and Bed height below. Every piece is made to fit this printer.

printer_width.title: Bed width
printer_width.description: Only used when Printer is Custom: the usable width (X) of your printer's bed.

printer_depth.title: Bed depth
printer_depth.description: Only used when Printer is Custom: the usable depth (Y) of your printer's bed.

printer_height.title: Bed height
printer_height.description: Only used when Printer is Custom: the tallest print your printer can make (Z).

wall.title: Wall
wall.description: Mould thickness round the outside of the part. Thicker is stiffer but uses more plastic.

back_plate.title: Back plate
back_plate.description: Thickness of the plate that closes the mould on the side opposite the open face (the face you pour into and trowel).

flange_width.title: Flange width
flange_width.description: How far the bolting flanges stand out from the mould. Needs at least 2.5 × the bolt hole, so the bolt has material round it.

flange_thickness.title: Flange thickness
flange_thickness.description: Both flanges of a joint together: each piece's flange is half this.

bolt.title: Bolts
bolt.description: Clearance holes in the flanges for M4 (4.5 mm), M5 (5.5), M6 (6.6) or M8 (9.0) bolts, about 150 mm apart. None: no bolt holes, for quick-release clamps.

dowel_diameter.title: Dowel pins
dowel_diameter.description: One dowel hole per joint (0.1 mm over this size) so the pieces line up the same way every time. 0 for no dowels.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: How many pieces round the jacket. 0: the plugin picks the fewest pieces that fit your printer.

core_pin_diameter.title: Core pin diameter
core_pin_diameter.description: Fills one round side hole through the part's wall so concrete can't run into it. 0 for no core pin.

core_pin_angle.title: Core pin angle
core_pin_angle.description: Direction of the side hole round the part, in degrees from +X towards +Y, seen from the back of the mould.

core_pin_height.title: Core pin height
core_pin_height.description: Height of the side hole's centre, measured from the open face.

part.title: Part body
part.description: The part to mould. Leave empty to use the selection: select the part, or click its open face (the flat face you pour into and trowel) to choose that face. With the whole part selected the open face is its bottom.

silicone_thickness.title: Silicone thickness
silicone_thickness.description: How thick the silicone liner is between the part and the sleeve. Pourable silicones need at least 10 mm to flow round the part and hold their shape (Amsil Eco: cover the model by at least 10 mm). Use 12 to 15 mm for thick silicones (Amsil Eco 40, 30 000 cps) or parts over about 300 mm. Thicker costs more silicone; the run reports how much.

wall.title: Wall
wall.description: Sleeve wall thickness. The sleeve only holds the silicone, so 6 to 10 mm is plenty.
